stem: Which of these is the best summary of Scene 1?

options.label: A
options.text: While Mike is visiting Carl during a rainstorm, they hear someone scream. Mike is frightened by it, but Carl is not.

options.label: B
options.text: Carl and Mike watch television during a thunderstorm. They hear a scream, and at first they think it has come from the TV.

options.label: C
options.text: As Carl and Mike begin to watch a mystery movie, they hear a scream. Carl goes outside to investigate, and Mike follows.

options.label: D
options.text: Mike is peeking through Carl’s curtains when he hears a scream. Someone is yelling for help.
